content.short: Metaschool is an educational platform where developers learn and build on Web3, earn NFTs for work, and connect with peers.
content.description: Metaschool is an educational platform where developers can come together to learn and build on Web3. It also offers the opportunity to earn NFTs for work and to connect with talented peers. Metaschool's educational program is largely focused on ERC721/A and ERC1155 token standards, Solidity, and Smart Contracts for EVM blockchains, with offerings expanding over time to cover additional topics and chains. This evolving curriculum supports developers as they deepen their Web3 knowledge and broaden their practical skills.
